topic.title: Highlights (v2.8.8)
topic.shortdesc: Key features and improvements in the current version.

ul.li: Windows long paths fixed: DITA-OT 4.x no longer fails with exit code 255 ("The input line is too long") in deeply nested projects. When the dita.bat command line would exceed the 8191-character cmd.exe limit, the transformation, validation and plugin install tasks run it through its 8.3 short path, or a temporary junction under %TEMP% where 8.3 names are disabled. Command lines that fit run exactly as before.
CI: DitaOtValidateTask now also runs for every tested DITA-OT version.

section.title: What's New in 2.8.7
section.p: A maintenance release with no change to the task DSL:

ul.li: Minimum Gradle 8.14.4: The minimum supported Gradle version is now 8.14.4 (previously 6.5). Gradle 8.14.4, 9.0 and 9.9.1 are tested in CI. On older Gradle versions, stay on 2.8.6.
DITA-OT 4.4.2: Tested in CI with a real HTML5 transformation on Linux and Windows. The examples now default to DITA-OT 4.4.2.
Up-to-date toolchain: Kotlin 2.4.21, commons-io 2.22.0, Gradle wrapper 9.9.1, with no compiler or Gradle deprecation warnings.

row.entry: Visual progress indicators with configurable warning display
Check for broken links with scope="peer" support
Validate DITA content with proper message classification
Download DITA-OT automatically with version management and caching
Install DITA-OT plugins from registry, URL, or local files
Contextual error messages with suggestions and troubleshooting
Windows, macOS, Linux support (paths with spaces supported)
Provider API, built with Kotlin 2.4, Gradle 8.14.4 – 9.9
